prompt:
Editorial still photograph, dark and dramatic. A single sheet of matte white paper lies flat on a seamless near-black paper backdrop, slightly rotated, lit by a single narrow slice of warm light from the right that falls across the sheet; the rest of the frame falls into deep shadow.
The sheet is a small web app, a simple expense splitter tool interface, built in AI Summer Adventure. It shows only the artifact's own content, never a caption or description of what it is, printed in clean modern sans-serif typography, near-black ink, generous margins and a clear hierarchy. Visible text, spelled exactly: "Expense splitter"; "Add a person"; "Settle up". One small printed teal (#5BC4C4) highlight on the "Settle up" button.
Nothing else in the frame: no hands, no people, no desk, no pens, no plants, no devices, no props, no logos. Moody, minimal, high-end print photography.
